summary: Frontend testing of (1) GlobalDestinations region filter tabs and (2) HomeBlogPreview rendering on the homepage. Both bug fixes verified working. 12/12 expected region tabs present, filtering works correctly, region labels on destination cards are accurate, blog preview section renders 3 cards with images/titles/excerpts, and View All link navigates to /blog successfully.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for 'Indian Ocean Islands' filter is 'region-filter-indian-ocean islands' (contains a space). `.replace(' ', '-')` only replaces the FIRST occurrence in JS. Should use `.replace(/ /g, '-')` or `.replaceAll(' ', '-')`. The review_request spec says testids should be hyphenated (e.g., 'region-filter-indian-ocean-islands').

action_items: Optional: Fix testid hyphenation for multi-word regions in GlobalDestinations.js line 93 — change `r.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')` to `r.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, '-')` so 'Indian Ocean Islands' becomes 'indian-ocean-islands' (currently 'indian-ocean islands' with a space).
Optional cleanup: Remove dead code on GlobalDestinations.js line 10 — `const ALL_REGIONS = [...]` is no longer used after refactor (replaced by dynamic `availableRegions` on line 62).
critical_code_review_comments: GlobalDestinations.js line 10: ALL_REGIONS constant is dead code post-refactor — should be deleted.

GlobalDestinations.js line 93: `.replace(' ', '-')` only replaces first space; multi-word region names like 'Indian Ocean Islands' produce malformed testids ('indian-ocean islands'). Use global regex.
Region key in DestCard list (`d.name`) is fine, but availableRegions list keyed by `r` — no functional issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on requested test scenarios (12/12 region tabs, 3/3 filter assertions, 3/3 region labels, blog preview + View All nav)

test_credentials: Not needed for these public-page tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes from this iteration are verified working on India (default) region view. All 12 expected region tabs (All, South Asia, East Asia, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, Middle East, North Africa, Africa, Indian Ocean Islands, Europe, South America, Oceania) render. Filtering correctly partitions destinations by region. Card labels show proper regions (India=South Asia, Japan=East Asia, Egypt=North Africa). HomeBlogPreview renders between GlobalDestinations and Testimonials with 3 cards loaded from /api/blog. Minor testid hyphenation bug noted (non-blocking). US/UK region views were not separately tested.
rca of the issue: Original bugs: (1) GlobalDestinations.js had hardcoded ALL_REGIONS array that did not match DB region taxonomy — fix derives regions dynamically via REGION_ORDER + actual destination.region values. (2) HomeBlogPreview was imported but never mounted in Home JSX — fix added <HomeBlogPreview /> between GlobalDestinations and Testimonials in App.js line 63. Both fixes confirmed working in browser.
